notes: Only a main article is provided (no SI). Samples with H2 uptake: ACNC10-900 and ACNC40-900, activated carbons from pistachio shells (Section 4.6). Both are carbon-majority by EDS (C 62.13 and 85.92 wt%, Table 2). H2 measured volumetrically (Micromeritics ASAP 2020 to 120 kPa; Sieverts PCT Pro to 5192 kPa), both at 77 K. SSA 579.4 m2/g (BET, N2 at 77 K) is tied to ACNC40-900 by the Conclusion and by Table 3; no separate SSA value was found for ACNC10-900. Not primary (original experimental article), is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF, no statement that the uptake values were published before. Flag for extractors: reported mmol/g and wt% disagree at high pressure (15.02 mmol/g = about 3.0 wt% by 0.201588 factor, but the paper gives 5.14 wt%; 13.69 mmol/g gives 2.76 wt%, paper gives 4.77 wt%); at 120 kPa 4.6 mmol/g = 0.93 wt%, paper gives 1.99 wt%. Total pore volume is given as 0.340 cm3/g in the abstract and 0.204 in Table 3. Not relevant to eligibility.
